findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: On arrival the facility did not have signed copies of the reporting agreements for the staff in the unit. Copies were signed during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: On arrival the hand sink (and the entire unit) was without paper towels. Paper towels were brought to the unit to correct. Ensure that the hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.
